_provenance: Dust VFX sub-rung of footstep response. Niagara particle system for footstep dust.
name: dust_vfx
walls: Dust particles must spawn within 0.1s of footstep impact
Particle count must be 50-200 per footstep on sand
Particle color must match surface material (sand=tan, rock=gray)
Particle size must be 0.5-5mm screen space at 1m distance

output.format: particle count, lifetime, color, size per surface
